summary: World Omni Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $1.316 billion asset-backed securitization of auto loan receivables. The offering includes Class A-1 through A-4, Class B, and Class C notes with principal amounts, interest rates, and final maturities ranging from May 2027 to July 2033. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account, overcollateralization, and subordination. This is a routine structured finance transaction, not a special situation. The filing discloses the terms of the note issuance but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event.
